product_metadata.title: Bridgewater Candle 18oz Large Soy Wax Blend Fragranced Jar Candle-Welcome Home
features: Fragrance Description: Imagine being welcomed home by a warm, friendly greeting of cinnamon, plum and apple accords wafting through the air.

CREATED WITH YOU IN MIND – Our candles consist of proprietary, clean burning soy-blend wax, timeless fragrances created in-house, lead-free cotton wicks, and a reusable 18.5 oz glass jar with a sealed lid lasting up to 145 hours.

LONG LASTING - A large jar candle will fill your home with its one-of-a-kind fragrance for up to 145 hours. TIP - Burn time can be maximized by allowing the wax pool to reach the edge of the glass before extinguishing the flame. This is regarded as an even-burn.

THANK YOU FOR FEEDING KIDS! Every time you purchase a Bridgewater candle, we donate 75 cents to Rice Bowls, a non-profit organization which provides the food budget for orphanages around the world where there is no government assistance for food. Each 75 cent donation provides 3 meals for a child in need through this partnership.
